mean_cn: adj.警告的；引以为戒的；  n.警告；告诫
mean_en: a statement, an event, etc. telling somebody that something bad or unpleasant may happen in the future so that they can try to avoid it
sentence: After the tree fell onto the road, they put a warning sign in front of it.
sentence_trans: 树倒在路上之后，他们在树前面放了一块警告牌。
word_etyma: warn警告 + ing表示……的 → warning警告的
